closed_world_justification: one sealed Hybrid pilot, one finite six-sample experiment, one exact branch, one exact final Git HEAD at materialization time, one canonical renderer, one exact validator, one route/destination, and one worktree-external exclusive bundle define the whole boundary
operational_definition: commit all source and evidence first; require the configured branch and a clean worktree; render existing canonical authorization with current HEAD; validate exact bytes and transport bindings; exclusively write authorization and hash-only receipt outside Git; verify HEAD and cleanliness again; allow no later Git write or commit
forbidden_narrowing: no ancestry or semantic-equivalence substitution for exact HEAD equality
no manual edit or date/head rewrite of the old authorization
no authorization artifact inside the Git worktree
no overwrite or reuse of an existing external bundle
no post-authorization Git write or commit
no signed approval, nonce, credential lookup, Provider client, network, model, paid call, sample execution, cutover, or Full Short
